cohort: 82,540 mother-infant pairs from the Japan Environment and Children's Study
finding: Primipara mothers had worse mother-infant bonding scores than multipara mothers, and among multipara mothers, those who underwent Cesarean delivery had worse scores than those who had vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Among multipara mothers without prior Cesarean section, Cesarean delivery was associated with worse mother-infant bonding scores compared to vaginal delivery.
